context: Riku and Aoi chat about a garage sale.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (旧/売っ/売る/きっかけ/そろそろ) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 旧いゲームを、売ろうと思うんだ。
lines.en: I'm thinking of selling my old games.
lines.style: cheerful teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: いいね、何がきっかけなの?
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 部屋が狭くなったのが、きっかけだよ。
lines.en: My room getting cramped was the trigger.
lines.style: animated teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 旧いソフトでも、売れるの?
lines.en: Even old software, will it sell?
lines.style: curious barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: レアなのは、高く売れるんだ。
lines.en: Rare ones sell for a high price.
lines.style: enthusiastic teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: そろそろ、私も片付けようかな。
lines.en: Maybe I'll tidy up soon too.
lines.style: engaged barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 昨日、一個売ったら、嬉しかったよ。
lines.en: I sold one yesterday and was happy.
lines.style: happy teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: そろそろ、一緒にフリマ出そうよ!
lines.en: Let's do a flea market together soon!
lines.style: bubbly barista voice, soft warm cheerful closing delivery throughout
